input.prompt: Clean brand identity concept sheet for a wordmark reading exactly "Instagram". Problem to fix: in the current design a single cursive 'r' joined to the 'a' is misread as a different letter. Design direction: a bold, simple, modern script wordmark with one consistent joining rule; the 'r' has a clear print-style stem and shoulder and is unmistakably an 'r'; every letter is legible at a glance. Tone: confident, warm, crafted. Show the wordmark large in black on a plain warm-white background, plus the same wordmark at small app-header size underneath to prove legibility. Flat vector style, high contrast, no mockup clutter, no logos, no icons, no extra text besides the wordmark.
input.negative_prompt: letter z, misspelling, extra letters, camera icon, gradient icon, mockup, phone, watermark, signature, additional text
